headline: Discussion of a 2026 Merrimack Conservation Partnership Grant proposal with Access Conservation.
summary: Bylaws, conservation easements, land acquisition, and outreach are also on the list. A staff update is included too.
items: Discussion with Access Conservation on developing a proposal for the 2026 Merrimack Conservation Partnership Grant
Discussion on conservation easements and conservation land acquisition
Discussion on Conservation Commission outreach initiatives
location: Walter Stiles Room, 2nd Floor, Manchester City Hall, One City Hall Plaza

1. Call to Order. 
2. Roll. 
3. Discussion with representatives of Access Conservation  regarding the development of a 
proposal to the 2026 Merrimack Conservation Partnership Grant. 
4. Discussion of Conservation Commission Bylaws. 
5. Discussion on conservation easements and conservation land acquisition. 
6. Discussion on Conservation Commission outreach initiatives. 
7. Review of prior meeting minutes. 
8. Staff update. 
9. Other business. 
10. Adjournment.
